locations.note: Dr Jonathan Reid, newly turned vampire, navigates 1918 London in the grip of the Spanish flu, across four districts drawn from the real East End.
Whitechapel's streets and the cemetery where Jonathan finds his sister Mary and their mother.
The Docks: the warehouses and wharves of the old London Docks, researched with the Isle of Dogs for the game's dockland district.
Lady Ashbury brings Jonathan to the West End and the Ascalon Club, the highborn vampires' society.
